name: empirical-tp-sl-optimizer
author: MEFAI
summary: Grid-search the take-profit / stop-loss bracket with the best risk-honest expectancy for a (symbol, timeframe, signal_type) slice, replayed from recorded barrier-touch times with no price re-simulation and no look-ahead.

inputs.name: symbol
inputs.description: Pair such as BTCUSDT; null pools across symbols.

inputs.name: timeframe
inputs.description: Signal timeframe such as 1h; null pools across timeframes.

inputs.name: signal_type
inputs.description: buy or sell; null pools both directions.

inputs.name: since_ts
inputs.description: Unix seconds floor; set to the submission-lock time to measure only fresh forward outcomes.

inputs.name: min_samples
inputs.description: Minimum resolved trades for a bracket to be eligible.

outputs.name: recommend
outputs.description: True only when the per-risk pick clears one standard error above zero and the sample gate.

outputs.name: best_per_risk
outputs.description: Risk-honest pick: tp, sl, rr, n, win_rate, payoff, expectancy, expectancy_stderr, expectancy_per_risk.

outputs.name: grid
outputs.description: All TP/SL cells sorted by expectancy-per-risk.

primary.description: Pre-recorded barrier-touch times for resolved MEFAI signals (181k labeled outcomes across 40+ assets and 7 timeframes in production; a pinned synthetic sample ships for reproducible backtests).

backtest.pass_criteria: Recommendation logic is consistent across every slice: recommend implies positive expectancy above one standard error with samples at or above min_samples.
